paper_title: Measuring (a Sufficient) World Model in LLMs A Variance Decomposition   Framework
caption: : Meaningful Variability Share
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of “Meaningful Variability Share” (MVS) across four distinct categories: Health and Nutrition, Logistics, Personal Finance, and Travel and Transportation. The horizontal axis displays the category names in alphabetical order, and the vertical axis represents the MVS value, ranging from 0.00 to 1.00, with a linear scale marked in increments of 0.05. The value axis is labeled “MVS (1-4 MVS),” and the tick labels represent values from 0.00 to 1.00 in 0.05 increments. Each bar corresponds to one of the four categories and is colored in green. The Health and Nutrition bar reaches a height of 0.700, the Logistics bar reaches a height of 0.600, the Personal Finance bar reaches a height of 0.600, and the Travel and Transportation bar reaches a height of 0.700. All bars are equally spaced and do not appear to be sorted or visually emphasized.
